title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: When considering loss functions, think about how they handle differences between predicted and actual values. A higher power in the loss function can amplify these differences, especially for larger errors.

title: Comparing Powers in Loss Functions
text: Consider how the power of the difference term affects the sensitivity of the loss function to outliers. Higher powers tend to increase sensitivity to larger errors.

title: Analyzing the Cubic Loss Function
text: Does the function sum{i\=1}{n}{(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**3} penalize larger errors more than the mean squared error (MSE)?

title: Exploring Absolute Cubic Loss
text: Consider the function sum{i\=1}{n}{abs(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**3}. How does the absolute value affect the treatment of errors compared to the cubic loss without absolute value?

title: Evaluating Quartic Loss
text: Does the function sum{i\=1}{n}{(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**4} penalize outliers more harshly than MSE?
